apply.text: Apply to the Maryland State Retirement Agency in writing; the Agency recommends beginning at least a year before the retirement date, and a former member's retirement starts on the first day of the month after the Board receives the written application.

sources.quote: You should begin the process at least one year before your anticipated retirement date.

sources.ref: Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 23-403
sources.quote: may retire with a retirement allowance under § 23-401 or § 23-402 of this subtitle on the first day of the month after the Board of Trustees receives a written application for retirement from the former member.
